page.overview:
Who is Egon?

Egon was the king of Lyria in the 1150s. He had twin daughters, Impecca and Rigoberta, who married heirs of the Cerbins.

Egon succeeded Berrik as ruler of Lyria, while another person became king of Rivia. At some point before , Egon hosted King Coram I and his younger brother Ceran at the palace in Lyria. During their stay, the two fell in love with Egon's daughters and married them shortly afterward. Impecca and Ceran remained in Lyria as heirs to the throne. Although he did not rule Rivia, a road in that kingdom would bear his name.
